title: Don't Guess, Just Ask: Evaluating Interactive Requirement Clarification for Repository-Level Software Development
abstract: arXiv:2610.13022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As LLMs become increasingly capable of implementing software, a critical bottleneck emerges: whether they truly understand what users want. Users often begin with vague intent, leaving important requirements to be clarified through interaction. In repository-level development, misunderstandings can propagate and cause costly rework. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate implementation from complete specifications or underspecified requests, overlooking pre-coding requirement clarification. Prior clarification studies mainly focus on function-level tasks. It therefore remains unclear how well LLMs can transform vague intent into clear requirements through interaction and how this capability affects subsequent code generation. translated_title: 不要猜测，直接询问：评估仓库级软件开发中的交互式需求澄清
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在软件实现方面的能力日益增强，一个关键瓶颈逐渐显现：它们是否真正理解用户想要什么。用户往往从模糊的意图出发，许多重要需求需要通过交互来澄清。在仓库级开发中，误解可能会持续传播并导致代价高昂的返工。然而，现有的基准测试通常基于完整规格说明或欠规范的请求来评估代码实现，忽视了编码前的需求澄清环节。以往关于需求澄清的研究主要聚焦于函数级任务。因此，目前尚不清楚LLM通过交互将模糊意图转化为清晰需求的能力究竟如何，以及这种能力会如何影响后续的代码生成。我们提出了ReqClarifyBench，一个面向仓库级软件开发的交互式需求澄清基准。它包含341个任务，涵盖游戏、小程序和网页开发，每个任务都带有……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ReqClarifyBench，一个包含341个任务（涵盖游戏、小程序和网页开发）的交互式需求澄清基准，用于评估LLM通过交互将模糊用户意图转化为清晰需求的能力及其对后续代码生成的影响。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ReqClarifyBench, an interactive requirement clarification benchmark with 341 tasks spanning game, miniapp, and web development, to evaluate how well LLMs transform vague user intent into clear requirements through interaction and how this capability affects subsequent code generation.
